name: transmediale
known: The 2026 edition, the 39th, ran from 28 January to 1 February 2026 at silent green Kulturquartier (Gerichtstraße 35) and CANK (Karl-Marx-Straße 95), curated by Neema Githere and Juan Pablo García Sossa (e-flux).
Artistic directors: Andreas Broeckmann (2001 to 2007), Stephen Kovats (from 2007), Kristoffer Gansing (from 2012) and Nóra Ó Murchú (from 2021, departure announced in July 2024) (Wikipedia).
